description.value: Perfecto Cafe is an artisan bakery-cafe chain with a North Vancouver outpost in the Shipyards district, where bakers work from 5am crafting croissants, cakes, gelato, and sandwiches entirely from scratch using a custom coffee blend developed exclusively with Agro Roasters. One of four Metro Vancouver locations, the Shipyards cafe sits at the waterfront Esplanade and draws on the same made-in-house philosophy as its sister cafes. Touring cyclists will find a full food stop with pastries, sandwiches, and specialty coffee in a welcoming community-oriented space.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 46m; rack (3 spaces) at 68m; rack at 91m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at perfectocafe.ca confirms the Shipyards location at 200 Esplanade W, North Vancouver, BC, V7M 1A6, directly matching the OSM address. The site characterizes the business as an artisan cafe/bakery rather than a grocery store, with no phone number listed for the Shipyards location specifically (other locations have phones, but not this one). No cyclist-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc. — are mentioned anywhere on the site; the FAQ only notes 'free and paid street parking nearby all our locations' for general vehicle parking.
concerns: No phone number listed for the Shipyards location on the website; OSM also has no phone — phone field left null.
Category 'Groceries' (derived from shop=bakery) understates that this is a cafe; a Cafe or Bakery/Cafe category would better represent the business.
OSM address uses 'West Esplanade' while website uses 'Esplanade W' — same street, different notation, not a meaningful discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Confirmed real, open, publicly accessible artisan cafe/bakery at the OSM address — a practical food and coffee stop for touring cyclists passing through the North Vancouver Shipyards area.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM shop=bakery is mapped to Groceries, but Perfecto Cafe operates as a full-service artisan cafe. A category of Cafe or Bakery/Cafe would more accurately represent the business.
